info.description: Policy configuration, custom policy, unit, and cache administration API.
info.title: Policy Service API

post.description: Evicts one relative key or invalidates one or more cache namespaces. Key and namespaces are mutually exclusive.

get.description: Returns active system policies merged with active wallet-specific overrides. An override replaces only an exact policy type, transaction type, channel, direction, and window type match.

parameters.description: Transaction type filter; ALL policies remain included
parameters.name: transactionType

put.description: Wallet, policy type, transaction type, channel, direction, window type, and creator are immutable.

delete.description: Deletes the group and its configured policies.

put.description: Policy group, type, transaction type, channel, and direction are immutable.
Code, unit, kind, and window type are immutable.

delete.description: Deletion is rejected when historical counters reference the type.

post.description: Evaluates the transaction against the sender's (OUT) and receiver's (IN) effective policies. When no limit is violated the usage is added and the status is RESERVED; otherwise nothing is added and the status is REJECTED. requestId is unique per month.

delete.description: Reverses a RESERVED reservation by its original requestId: each RESERVE ledger entry is recorded again as a RELEASE entry with the opposite delta and subtracted from the same usage window. Only RESERVED can be released; anything else is 409.

base.description: Base makes an AUXILIARY value a percentage of it; absent: flat amount.

cap.description:
Cap is the most an AUXILIARY policy charges per window, in its unit;
required with a window, absent otherwise.

effectiveFrom.description: EffectiveFrom defaults to now on create and is required on update.

isEnforced.description:
IsEnforced false keeps the policy out of the engine: it is only
returned as config (e.g. balance limits for accounting). Defaults to
true on create and keeps the current value on update.

kind.description: Kind picks the strategy that evaluates the policy.

operator.description: Operator compares a LIMIT; required for LIMIT, absent otherwise.

role.description: Role is how an AUXILIARY charge applies; required for AUXILIARY.

unitId.description:
UnitID (units table) is what a LIMIT or WAIVER measures, or what an
AUXILIARY cap counts; required for LIMIT and WAIVER.

x-enum-comments.KindAuxiliary: charges: fee, discount, tax, by role
x-enum-comments.KindLimit: blocks a transaction that breaks a bound
x-enum-comments.KindWaiver: waives the fee while usage is under a bound

x-enum-comments.RoleDiscount: taken off; at most the fee (or the amount, for cashback); publishes NET_FEE
x-enum-comments.RoleFee: paid; zero while a waiver applies; publishes base FEE

charge.description:
Charge is what this AUXILIARY line charges, signed like Charges, after
its window cap and before the type's own caps (a discount at most the
fee) are applied to the totals.

usage.description: Usage is the window total including this request (not stored when rejected).

charges.description:
Charges is what each AUXILIARY role charges this side, in role order;
a discount is negative. The side pays their sum.
